name: How long does an exterior stonework project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an exterior stonework project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior stonework project depends on its scope and complexity. A small accent wall might be completed in a few days, while an entire home facade could take several weeks. Weather conditions can also impact timelines, especially during the hot Texas summers. A practical tradeoff is balancing project speed with precision; rushing can compromise quality, so we prioritize careful installation for lasting results.
